notes.title: Update: Merge Hints, Locking System, and Screen Adaptation
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! Thanks so much for playing and supporting my game 🙌
Based on recent player feedback, this update brings a number of new features and improvements for a smoother and more enjoyable experience.[/p][p]🌟 [b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Save files now restore the countdown timers in progress[/p][/*][*][p]Added control instructions to help new players get started[/p][/*][*][p]Orders now highlight in color once completed[/p][/*][*][p]Added info icons for clearer guidance[/p][/*][*][p]Number changes now have animated effects for better feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Added distinct colors for locked and unlocked cards[/p][/*][*][p]Press [b]Spacebar[/b] to pause or resume the game anytime[/p][/*][*][p]Added resolution auto-scaling for different screens[/p][/*][/list][p]⚖️ [b]Balance & Progression[/b][/p][list][*][p]Certain cards are now auto-unlocked without popup prompts[/p][/*][*][p]Improved card unlocking logic for a more natural progression[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the order of information in the Summary window[/p][/*][/list][p]🎮 [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buildings now display the products they can produce[/p][/*][*][p]Cards now display the items they can merge into[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over a card shows its possible merge results[/p][/*][*][p]Locked cards can no longer be moved, preventing mistakes[/p][/*][/list][p]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some seeds could not be unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed problems with mouse dragging behavior[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all your feedback! 🙏
If you spot any issues or have suggestions, please feel free to share them in the community.
I’ll keep improving the game step by step to bring you a better and better experience![/p]

notes.title: First Update: Better Experience & Summary Window
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! Thanks so much for playing and supporting my game 🙌
Based on recent player feedback, I’ve made a number of improvements and adjustments to provide a smoother and more relaxing experience.[/p][p]🌟 [b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a Farm Summary Window to make progressing into a new farm feel more rewarding and ceremonial[/p][/*][/list][p]⚖️ [b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized the order system to reduce player pressure[/p][/*][*][p]Improved wave pacing and waiting times for a more natural flow[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out the progression speed of building unlocks and development[/p][/*][/list][p]🎮 [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted some settings to make the overall experience more relaxing[/p][/*][*][p]Refined interaction details to avoid unreasonable situations[/p][/*][/list][p]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues with audio controls not working properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain save/load problems[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your feedback! 🙏
If you discover any issues or have suggestions, please share them in the community. I’ll keep improving the game so the experience gets better and better![/p]
